Key Finding: In 2024, 31.6% of internet users in Eastern Visayas reported buying goods or services online.
APA Reference: Philippine Statistics Authority. (2025, September 2). Eastern Visayas region: E-commerce (preliminary results) [Infographic]. https://rsso08.psa.gov.ph/system/files/infographics/EV-2024%20NICTHS%20E-Commerce.pdf

Key Finding: VSU’s Society of Agribusiness Students lists a week-long fundraising booth during the university anniversary among its campus activities.
APA Reference: Visayas State University. (n.d.). Society of Agribusiness Students. https://www.vsu.edu.ph/21-content-main/informational/939-dbm-sabs

Key Finding: Among 217 prospective Amazon users, familiarity with the seller and trust in it were associated with willingness to ask about books as well as to buy them.
APA Reference: Gefen, D. (2000). E-commerce: The role of familiarity and trust. Omega, 28(6), 725–737. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0305-0483(00)00021-9

Key Finding: In Eastern Visayas, 70.4% of online purchasers aged 10 or older used a smartphone for online purchases in 2024.
APA Reference: Philippine Statistics Authority. (2025, September 2). Eastern Visayas region: E-commerce (preliminary results) [Infographic]. https://rsso08.psa.gov.ph/system/files/infographics/EV-2024%20NICTHS%20E-Commerce.pdf

Key Finding: In 2024, 34.2% of Eastern Visayas households had an internet connection at home.
APA Reference: Philippine Statistics Authority. (2025, September 2). Eastern Visayas region: Households’ access to internet (preliminary results) [Infographic]. https://rsso08.psa.gov.ph/system/files/infographics/EV-2024%20NICTHS%20Individual%20and%20HH%20Access.pdf

Key Finding: A verified Google ID token identifies a managed account’s domain through its hosted-domain claim, which provides evidence of membership beyond the email suffix.
APA Reference: Google. (2026, November 19). Authenticate with a backend server. Google for Developers. https://developers.google.com/identity/sign-in/web/backend-auth

Key Finding: Clothing, footwear, sporting goods, or accessories were the most commonly purchased category among Eastern Visayas online buyers aged 10 or older in 2024.
APA Reference: Philippine Statistics Authority. (2025, September 2). Eastern Visayas region: E-commerce (preliminary results) [Infographic]. https://rsso08.psa.gov.ph/system/files/infographics/EV-2024%20NICTHS%20E-Commerce.pdf

Key Finding: Eastern Visayas households with home internet spent an average of PHP 936 per month on their connection in 2024.
APA Reference: Philippine Statistics Authority. (2025, September 2). Eastern Visayas region: Households’ access to internet (preliminary results) [Infographic]. https://rsso08.psa.gov.ph/system/files/infographics/EV-2024%20NICTHS%20Individual%20and%20HH%20Access.pdf

Key Finding: Researchers estimated that just 16% of used books sold on Amazon displaced a new-book sale.
APA Reference: Ghose, A., Smith, M. D., & Telang, R. (2006). Internet exchanges for used books: An empirical analysis of product cannibalization and welfare impact. Information Systems Research, 17(1), 3–19. https://doi.org/10.1287/isre.1050.0072

Key Finding: A review of textile life-cycle studies found that most environmental gains from reuse depend on whether a used garment replaces production of a new one.
APA Reference: Sandin, G., & Peters, G. M. (2018). Environmental impact of textile reuse and recycling – A review. Journal of Cleaner Production, 184, 353–365. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2018.02.266

Key Finding: UNEP estimated that food service accounted for 28% and retail for 12% of global food waste across households, food service, and retail in 2022.
APA Reference: United Nations Environment Programme. (2024). Food waste index report 2024. https://wedocs.unep.org/handle/20.500.11822/45230

Key Finding: Philippine solid waste policy identifies reuse as a way to reduce waste volume before collection and disposal.
APA Reference: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000, Republic Act No. 9003, § 2 (2001). https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9003_2001.html

Key Finding: VSU assigns oversight of personal information handled by the university to a data protection officer who reports to its president.
APA Reference: Visayas State University. (n.d.). General privacy notice. https://www.vsu.edu.ph/about/privacy

Key Finding: VSU’s student activity permit process calls for a budget allocation with applications for income-generating projects and routes approval through the dean of students.
APA Reference: Visayas State University, University Student Services Office. (n.d.). Citizen’s charter. https://www.vsu.edu.ph/images/ok_USSO_Citizens_Charter.pdf

Key Finding: The Philippine Internet Transactions Act created an Electronic Commerce Bureau within the Department of Trade and Industry.
APA Reference: Internet Transactions Act of 2023, Republic Act No. 11967 (2023). https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2023/ra_11967_2023.html

Key Finding: Philippine privacy law limits personal data retention to the time needed for the collection purpose, legal claims, legitimate business needs, or a legal requirement.
APA Reference: Data Privacy Act of 2012, Republic Act No. 10173, § 11 (2012). https://privacy.gov.ph/Data-Privacy-Act/

Key Finding: The Philippine Internet Transactions Act covers qualifying online sales by businesses to consumers and expressly excludes consumer-to-consumer transactions.
APA Reference: Internet Transactions Act of 2023, Republic Act No. 11967 (2023). https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2023/ra_11967_2023.html

Key Finding: The Philippine Food Safety Act addresses misleading descriptions of food regardless of the medium used to present them.
APA Reference: Food Safety Act of 2013, Republic Act No. 10611, § 8 (2013). https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2013/ra_10611_2013.html

Key Finding: In an Airbnb experiment, otherwise identical requests were 16% less likely to be accepted when the guest name was perceived as African American rather than White.
APA Reference: Edelman, B., Luca, M., & Svirsky, D. (2017). Racial discrimination in the sharing economy: Evidence from a field experiment. American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, 9(2), 1–22. https://doi.org/10.1257/app.20160213

Key Finding: The OECD found that manipulative interface designs can steer consumers toward decisions that work against their interests.
APA Reference: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development. (2022). Dark commercial patterns (OECD Digital Economy Papers No. 336). OECD Publishing. https://doi.org/10.1787/44f5e846-en

Key Finding: WCAG 2.2 calls for a text equivalent for informative images so people can access the same information through speech, braille, or other formats.
APA Reference: World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web content accessibility guidelines (WCAG) 2.2. https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/
